A New Map of Coastal Erosion

Researchers at an invented coastal institute have published a map that ranks every mile of the region's shoreline by how fast it is retreating, using forty years of aerial photographs and a new survey flown last winter.

The fastest-retreating stretches lose more than six feet a year, the map shows, and most of them sit beside roads or homes built in the 1970s.
